name: Agent inbox
author: wizard
description: Background tasks each keep one short record in an agent inbox (read by the Agent Service, wizard-agent-service issue 549). Their worker threads stay out of the chat list, Activity and unread counts but open from any link, and Chats gets a Running view: what is still working, how long, and which went quiet for 6 hours (wizard-ux issue 1569). A new task said to the orb can start in the background with a short Got it note and no new thread (wizard-ux issue 1588).
